tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end
Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable.
The bidders need to register with e-procurement portal and to obtain User ID and Password for participating in e-procurement
Interested bidders can get the information through the following web portal: https://www.kppp.karnataka.gov.in
The tenders are liable for rejection if any of the above said requirements are not complied with.
The bidder shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his/her tender, and the purchaser will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs.
The cost of the tender Processing is not being refundable.
The purchaser is not responsible for any delay in accessing e-procurement portal
The University does not bind itself to accept the lowest bidder and the university reserves the right to Accept or Reject any of the tender or all the tenders without assigning any reasons.
The authority reserves the Right to Accept or Reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons.

The quoted price should be inclusive of all types of taxes (service tax, VAT, sales tax), GST, Customs duty, clearance charges, transportation, erection(commission), excise duty etc., & all incidental charges F.O.R Bengaluru-560001,
IMP: FINANCIAL BID WILL BE OPENED AFTER COMPLETE EVALUATION OF THE TECHNICAL DACUMENTS
For any clarification tenderer may contact Mr. Raghavendra. Mobile No.7411389527 (Only during office hours).

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder must have successfully executed at least one IT project for a government or quasi-government organization, with a value of not less than 80% of the tender amount (in lakhs). Supporting documents as proof must be submitted
Signed Tender Application Form with the Name of the Firm with full Address, contact details, E-mail address, etc., on the letterhead of the bidder.
The Bidder should be a Private Limited Company, a Public Sector undertaking, or a government agency incorporated in India. A copy of the registration certificate must be enclosed.

If the tenderer is an Authorized dealer or reseller, the manufacturers authorization form should be submitted for Passive, switches, and surveillance. Manufacturers authorization is mandatory. Any bids submitted by an authorized dealer or reseller without a valid authorization will result in disqualification
The compliance statement of the bidder should be on the letterhead for the tender specifications, as per the format

The Bidder should upload the solution document signed by The Registrar (Administration), Maharani Cluster University, Bengaluru, confirming the compatibility of the proposed Access Switches, Surveillance, along with the Network drawing, on or before the Bid submission date, and the signed solution document.
